d: Long, flowing charcoal-grey hair with blunt bangs and a side-swept partition is paired with sharp, narrow light-blue eyes behind silver-rimmed glasses. The face is that of a mature adolescent with a slender, lean build. The outfit is a white sailor-style shirt with a navy blue collar, a red necktie, and a pleated navy blue skirt, accented by a red decorative tassel on the chest and grey long-sleeved undershirts. Signature details include a thin teal headband and a grey mechanical rigging piece attached to the waist.
